# Fill with a non-zero literal broadcasts the constant. Unlike zero, the compiler
# does not optimize these: 750 ns scalar against 27 ns for a 4 KiB byte slice.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func FillFloat64s(dst []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 2.5
	}
}

func FillUint8s(dst []byte) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0xfe
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func FillFloat64s(dst []float64) {
	_vcFloat64s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(2.5)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s0.StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func FillUint8s(dst []byte) {
	_vcUint8s1 := simd.BroadcastUint8s(0xfe)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_n := _vcUint8s1.StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 2 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func FillFloat64s(dst []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 2.5
	}
}

func FillUint8s(dst []byte) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0xfe
	}
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	f := make([]float64, 21)
	test.FillFloat64s(f)
	sum := 0.0
	for _, v := range f {
		sum += v
	}
	fmt.Println(sum)
	u := make([]byte, 37)
	test.FillUint8s(u)
	n := 0
	for _, v := range u {
		n += int(v)
	}
	fmt.Println(n)
}
-- testmain/output --
52.5
9398
